crossRefs.note: He sighed deeply in his spirit, and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign…
Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet…
for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.
He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to…
Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees…
Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and…
Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen…
I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his…
Wake up righteously, and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

translations.web: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”
translations.bsb: Then He asked them, “Do you still not understand?”
translations.kjv: And he said unto them, How is it that ye do not understand?
translations.asv: And he said unto them, Do ye not yet understand?
